claim.claim-text: 2. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 1, wherein a bottom end of the central main support rod is provided with a guide seat for forming a guide rail, and the first fastening ropes pass through the guide rail.

3. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 1, wherein a top end of the extension rod is provided with a fixed seat for forming a hanging hole, and one end of each second fastening rope is fixedly connected to the hanging hole.
4. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 1, wherein the extension rod is a cylindrical hollow tube, with a second accommodating cavity formed inside.

5. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 4, wherein the extension rod is provided with a first hanging rod that extends radially and penetrates the second accommodating cavity.
6. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 5, wherein the first elastic member and the second elastic member are helical springs.

7. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 6, wherein one end of the first elastic member is hooked to the first hanging rod, and the other end is connected to the first fastening ropes.

8. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 5, wherein the central main support rod is provided with a second hanging rod that extends radially along the central main support rod and penetrates the first accommodating cavity; and one end of the second elastic member is hooked to the second hanging rod, and the other end abuts against a bottom end of the extension rod.
9. The reinforcement assembly for a tent frame according to claim 1, wherein four first fastening ropes are provided and four second fastening ropes are provided.

10. A tent frame, comprising: at least three corner posts extending longitudinally in a vertical direction; at least three sets of transverse frame beams, each set of transverse frame beams slidably connecting two adjacent corner posts through a sleeve assembly; and a reinforcement assembly, comprising: a central main support rod extending in the vertical direction, with a first accommodating cavity formed inside; and an extension rod slidably inserted into the first accommodating cavity; and a plurality of first fastening ropes, each with one end connected to a corner post of the tent frame and the other end extending into the first accommodating cavity and converging for connection; and a first elastic member positioned in a convergence area and connected to the extension rod, configured to generate a continuous pre-tension force when the tent frame is deployed, transmitting a tensioning force to the corner posts through the first fastening ropes to enhance frame stability; and a plurality of second fastening ropes, each connected between the extension rod and the corner post, forming a horizontal tension network; and a second elastic member positioned at a bottom of the first accommodating cavity and abutting against the extension rod, configured to generate an upward return force when the extension rod is pressed downward by an external force from a canopy, dynamically counteracting a downward pressure and inhibiting displacement of the extension rod; wherein the tent frame further comprises at least three sets of net-like support arms, each set connecting the transverse frame beam and the central main support rod.

11. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein the central main support rod is provided with a first mounting base and a second mounting base, and the net-like support arms are fixedly connected to the central main support rod through the first mounting base and the second mounting base.

12. The tent frame according to claim 11, wherein the first mounting base is slidably arranged on an outer surface of the central main support rod, and the second mounting base is fixedly embedded at a bottom of the central main support rod.

14. The tent frame according to claim 11, wherein the first mounting base and the second mounting base are provided with mounting hole positions; and the net-like support arms are rotatably and fixedly connected to the mounting hole positions of the first mounting base and the second mounting base through bolt structures.

15. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein a top of the corner post is provided with a connection seat, and the connection seat is provided with a through hole; and one end of the first fastening rope and one end of the second fastening rope are fixed to the through hole of the connection seat through a hook assembly.

16. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein the corner post is configured as a telescopic tube structure, comprising: an outer tube, an inner tube, and a locking mechanism, wherein the inner tube and outer tube are fixed and locked at selected length positions by the locking mechanism.
17. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein the transverse frame beam is axially positioned along the corner post through a snap-fit structure.

18. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein four first fastening ropes are provided, and the bottom of the central main support rod is provided with a guide seat; and the guide seat is provided with four guide rails, and the first fastening ropes are threaded through the guide rails.
19. The tent frame according to claim 10, wherein the extension rod is a hollow cylindrical rod having an opening at a top thereof, and a fixed seat is embedded at the opening.
20. The tent frame according to claim 19, wherein the fixed seat is provided with a hanging hole, and one end of the second fastening rope is fixed to the hanging hole through a hook assembly.
